scope: bounded reproducible SU(2) Wilson-action Markov-chain ensemble generation and diagnostics

literature_basis.heatbath_reference: Michael Creutz, Phys. Rev. D 21, 2308 (1980), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevD.21.2308
literature_basis.overrelaxation_reference: Frank R. Brown and Thomas J. Woch, Phys. Rev. Lett. 58, 2394 (1987), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.58.2394
literature_basis.implementation_claim: the code independently implements the stated local conditional density and microcanonical reflection under the frozen repository conventions

rng.state_transition: state=state+0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 mod 2^64 followed by the frozen SplitMix64 mixing function
rng.uniform_f64: high 53 output bits multiplied by 2^-53, yielding [0,1)

update_order.markov_sweep: one complete heatbath sweep followed by the configured number of complete overrelaxation sweeps

su2_heatbath.staple: V=sum of the six oriented staples from frozen YM-SU2-LATTICE-V1
su2_heatbath.factorization: V=k Vhat with k=sqrt(sum_i V_i^2) and Vhat in SU(2) when k>0
su2_heatbath.conditional_density: dP(R) proportional to exp(alpha r0) d_mu_Haar(R), alpha=beta*k
su2_heatbath.scalar_proposal: r0 is proposed from the exact truncated exponential density proportional to exp(alpha r0) on [-1,1]
su2_heatbath.haar_jacobian_acceptance: accept scalar proposal with probability sqrt(1-r0^2)
su2_heatbath.vector_direction: conditional on accepted r0, vector direction is uniform on S^2
su2_heatbath.link_reconstruction: U_new=R Vhat^dagger; when k=0 use U_new=R
su2_heatbath.bounded_rejection: failure to accept within max_heatbath_attempts_per_link returns an error

su2_overrelaxation.formula: U_new=Vhat^dagger U_old^dagger Vhat^dagger for nonzero staple norm
su2_overrelaxation.purpose: microcanonical decorrelation step; it is not an ergodic sampler by itself

schedule.thermalization: discard thermalization_sweeps complete Markov sweeps before measurements
schedule.measurement_cadence: perform sweeps_between_measurements complete Markov sweeps before each recorded measurement

autocorrelation_diagnostics.mean: arithmetic mean of recorded plaquette measurements
autocorrelation_diagnostics.rho_lag: C_lag/C_0 with C_lag using divisor N-lag
autocorrelation_diagnostics.window: sum positive rho_lag values from lag 1 until the first non-positive lag; later lags are reported but not added
